note: One entry per vehicle we are asked for by name. This is editorial, not inventory: the fleet and the rates come from the panel, and a model listed here shows its live rate when the panel has one. Written per car on purpose -- six pages that are one page with the name swapped are doorway pages, and Google treats a site that has them as less trustworthy overall. If there is nothing particular to say about a vehicle, it should not have a page.

models.name: Maruti Suzuki Swift
models.luggage: Two medium suitcases, or one large and a couple of bags
models.title: Swift Self Drive Car Rental in Nagercoil & Kanyakumari
models.description: Rent a Maruti Swift without a driver in Nagercoil and across Kanyakumari district. Petrol, manual, 5 seats. Clear KM limit and a deposit you get back.
models.intro: The Swift is the car most people picture when they think of a self-drive hatchback, and it is the one we hand over most often. It is short, light to steer and returns the kind of mileage that matters when a day out means two hundred kilometres of coast road. Ask for a self drive Swift in Nagercoil or Kanyakumari and this is usually the car that arrives.
models.suits: Couples, a family of three or four, and anyone who is going to be parking in Nagercoil town rather than only on the highway.
models.drive: The steering is light and the turning circle is small, which is what you want in the streets around the Nagaraja temple and the market, where a wider car has to be reversed out of things. The flip side is a firm ride: over the broken stretches inland towards Thiruvattar you feel more of the road than you would in a Grand i10. On the Kanyakumari highway it sits comfortably at highway speeds and is quiet enough to talk in.
good: Easy to park anywhere in town, including the older streets
Light clutch and gearshift, which tells in stop-start traffic
The best fuel economy of the hatchbacks we keep
models.watch: The ride is on the firm side, and the boot takes two medium cases rather than three. For five adults with luggage for a week, take the Rumion or the Innova instead.

goesWellWith.label: Monthly rental, if you are staying a while

faq.question: Is the Swift available as an automatic?
faq.answer: The Swift we keep is a manual. If you would rather not use a clutch, take the Glanza Automatic — it is the automatic in our fleet and it is the same size of car to park.

faq.question: Will a Swift take five adults to Kanyakumari and back?
faq.answer: For the twenty kilometres to Kanyakumari, yes, comfortably enough. For a full day with five adults and bags, a seven-seater is the honest answer — the Swift's back seat is a three-person bench, and the boot is the limit before the seat is.

faq.question: What mileage does it give on a Kanyakumari trip?
faq.answer: On a mixed run of town and highway you can expect somewhere around 18 to 20 kilometres to the litre with a light foot. Fuel is yours on a self-drive rental, so this is a real difference between a Swift and a seven-seater over a long day.

faq.question: Can I get a self drive Swift in Nagercoil the same day?
faq.answer: Usually yes. Nagercoil is where the cars are kept, so a Swift that is free can be with you the same day and often within the hour — at Nagercoil Junction, at the Vadasery bus stand or at your own door. Bring your driving licence and a government photo ID, and the KM limit and deposit are agreed before you take it.

models.name: Toyota Glanza Automatic
models.luggage: Two medium suitcases and a soft bag
models.title: Glanza Automatic Self Drive Car Rental in Nagercoil
models.description: Rent a Toyota Glanza automatic without a driver in Nagercoil and Kanyakumari district. No clutch, 5 seats, petrol. Delivered to you, deposit refunded.
models.intro: The Glanza is our automatic. No clutch, no gear lever to think about — which sounds like a small thing until you are in the queue on the Nagercoil bypass at six in the evening, or you have spent the last ten years driving an automatic somewhere else. It is the only one in the fleet, so a self drive automatic car in Nagercoil or Kanyakumari district means this one.
models.suits: Anyone who has not driven a manual in years, visitors home from the Gulf, Singapore or Malaysia, and anybody who would rather spend a day of Indian traffic thinking about the road instead of the clutch.
models.drive: In town it does the thing automatics do: the car creeps forward on its own and you steer. On the open road to Kanyakumari or up towards Thirparappu it holds a gear sensibly and does not hunt. The cabin is a little wider than the Swift's, so three in the back is less of a negotiation. It is the same footprint to park.
good: No clutch — the single biggest difference in town traffic
The roomiest cabin of the hatchbacks we keep
models.watch: An automatic uses a little more fuel than the same car as a manual, and fuel is yours on a self-drive rental. Over a week that is real money, so if you are happy with a clutch the Swift or the Grand i10 will cost less to run.

goesWellWith.label: Booking from abroad before you land
By the month, for a long stay

faq.question: I have an overseas licence. Can I rent the automatic?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring your passport, your home licence and an international driving permit alongside it. We take copies at handover, the same as for anyone else. The automatic is usually the one visitors ask for, so it is worth booking it before you land.

faq.question: Is an automatic harder to drive on the ghat roads?
faq.answer: No — easier, if anything. On the climbs inland you are not changing gear on a slope, and coming down you can hold a lower gear. What it will not do is engine-brake as hard as a manual in low gear, so give yourself more room on a long descent.

faq.question: Is the Glanza the same as a Baleno?
faq.answer: It is the same car underneath, sold by Toyota rather than Maruti, with Toyota's badge and service. For a rental it makes no practical difference to you except the name on the front.

faq.question: Where can I rent a self drive automatic car in Nagercoil?
faq.answer: Here — the Glanza is the automatic we keep, and it is delivered anywhere we go in Kanyakumari district: Nagercoil and its two railway stations, the Vadasery bus stand, Kanyakumari, or your own door. There is one of it, so dates matter more for this car than for the manuals.

models.name: Hyundai Grand i10
models.title: Hyundai Grand i10 Self Drive Rental, Kanyakumari District
models.description: Self drive Hyundai Grand i10 rental in Nagercoil, Marthandam and across Kanyakumari district. Petrol, manual, 5 seats. Rates and KM limits agreed upfront.
models.intro: If the Swift is the sharp one, the Grand i10 is the comfortable one. Softer suspension, a light clutch and a cabin that feels a size bigger than the car looks — it is the hatchback we hand to somebody who has not driven for a while. A self drive Grand i10 is delivered wherever we go — Nagercoil, Marthandam, Thuckalay and the towns between.
models.suits: First-time renters, families of four, and anyone whose route includes the inland roads where the surface is patchy.
models.drive: The suspension is set up for rough surfaces rather than for cornering, which is the right trade for most of this district: the road out towards Thiruvattar and Thirparappu is exactly where you notice it. Controls are light all round. It is a touch softer through fast corners than a Swift, so it rewards an unhurried pace, which is the pace these roads want anyway.
good: The most comfortable ride of the hatchbacks over broken surfaces
Light controls — an easy car to get used to quickly
Good visibility out of the front and sides
models.watch: The soft setup means more body roll on a fast road. It is not a car to hurry on the highway, and the boot is the same two-case story as the Swift.

goesWellWith.label: What it costs by the day, week or month

faq.question: Is the Grand i10 good for a first-time self-drive rental?
faq.answer: It is the one we usually suggest. The clutch is light, the visibility is good and nothing about it is sharp or sudden. If you have not driven in India before, this or the Glanza Automatic is where to start.

faq.question: Can it handle the road to Thirparappu falls?
faq.answer: Yes. It is a tarred road the whole way with some broken stretches, and the Grand i10's softer suspension is better suited to it than a firmer car. Take it steadily over the rough sections and there is nothing there a hatchback cannot do.

faq.question: How many bags fit?
faq.answer: Two medium suitcases in the boot, or one large case and soft bags on the parcel shelf. Four people with a week's luggage is the point at which to move up to a seven-seater.

faq.question: Do you deliver a self drive Grand i10 outside Nagercoil?
faq.answer: Yes. We deliver across Kanyakumari district rather than asking anyone to come and collect — Marthandam, Thuckalay, Colachel, Kanyakumari and the towns between. Further out it is worth telling us the day before rather than the morning of.

models.name: Maruti Suzuki WagonR
models.luggage: Two medium suitcases, and a tall boot for awkward shapes
models.title: WagonR Self Drive Car Rental in Nagercoil, Kanyakumari
models.description: Rent a Maruti WagonR without a driver in Nagercoil and Kanyakumari district. Tall cabin, easy to get in and out of, 5 seats, petrol. Deposit refunded.
models.intro: The WagonR is the tall one, and that is the whole point of it. High roof, upright seats and big doors — you step in rather than drop down into it, and you step out the same way. A self drive WagonR in Nagercoil is the one to ask for when getting in and out matters most.
models.suits: Anyone travelling with older parents or grandparents, anyone with a knee or a back that objects to a low seat, and temple visits where the parking is tight and the streets are narrow.
models.drive: You sit high and see over the traffic, which makes town driving less of a guess. It is narrow for its height, so it goes down streets a wider car has to back out of — worth knowing around Suchindram and the older parts of Nagercoil. In return it feels the wind on the open coastal stretch towards Colachel, so it is happier at an easy pace than a hurried one.
good: The easiest car in the fleet to get in and out of
You sit high, so you can see over traffic
Narrow enough for the old temple streets, with a tall boot
models.watch: The tall body catches side wind on the open coast road, and it is the least settled of our hatchbacks at highway speed. For a long run to Thiruvananthapuram, take the Innova.

goesWellWith.label: Ask us to bring it to your door

faq.question: Is the WagonR easier for elderly passengers?
faq.answer: That is the main reason to choose it. The seat is at about the height of a dining chair rather than down near the floor, and the doors open wide, so getting in and out does not involve lowering yourself into the car.

faq.question: Will it fit down the streets around the temples?
faq.answer: Better than most. It is genuinely narrow for how roomy it feels inside, which is exactly what you want around Suchindram or the older parts of Nagercoil where the street was laid out long before cars.

faq.question: Is it comfortable on the highway?
faq.answer: For district distances, yes. For a long highway run — Thiruvananthapuram airport and back, say — a lower, heavier car like the Innova is the more settled choice, particularly when it is windy on the coast.

faq.question: Can I rent a self drive WagonR in Kanyakumari for a temple trip?
faq.answer: Yes, and it is a sensible choice for one. It is delivered to Kanyakumari — the railway station, your hotel, or wherever you are staying — and the tall doors and short body are what make it easy at a temple where the parking is tight and somebody in the group would rather not climb down into a low seat.

models.name: Toyota Rumion
models.luggage: Modest with all seven seats up; large with the third row folded
models.title: Toyota Rumion 7 Seater Self Drive Rental in Kanyakumari
models.description: Self drive Toyota Rumion in Nagercoil and across Kanyakumari district. Seven seats, petrol, manual. For family groups and temple trips. Clear KM limits.
models.intro: The Rumion is a seven-seater that runs on petrol, and that combination is why people take it. For a family group staying inside the district it costs noticeably less to run over a day than a diesel seven-seater, without giving up the seats. Ask for a seven seater self drive car in Nagercoil or Kanyakumari and this is the petrol one.
models.suits: Family groups of five to seven, temple circuits, and weekend trips where everybody wants to travel in one vehicle rather than two.
models.drive: It drives much like a large hatchback rather than like a van — the controls are light and it is not intimidating to place on a narrow road. The middle row is the comfortable one; the third row is genuinely usable for children and for adults over shorter distances. On the coast road to Colachel and the run out to Kanyakumari it is an easy, unhurried vehicle.
good: Seven seats without diesel running costs
Light to drive for its size
The middle row slides, so you can trade legroom between rows two and three
models.watch: With all seven seats up the boot is small — enough for a day out, not for seven people's luggage. For a wedding party or a multi-day tour with bags, the Innova is the one.

goesWellWith.label: Tourist vehicles, with a driver if you prefer

faq.question: Can seven adults actually sit in a Rumion?
faq.answer: Seven adults fit for a trip across the district. For a long day, the honest arrangement is five adults and two children, or six adults with the middle row slid back. The third row is a real seat, not a token one, but it is the smallest.

faq.question: Rumion or Innova for a family trip?
faq.answer: Rumion if you are staying in the district and watching the fuel bill — it is petrol and lighter. Innova if you are going further, carrying luggage for everybody, or want the most comfortable third row. We will tell you which is free on your dates either way.

faq.question: Is there luggage space with all seven seats in use?
faq.answer: Enough for a day out — bags, water, a couple of small cases. Not enough for seven people's suitcases. Fold the third row and the boot becomes large, which is how most people use it: six travelling, or seven with light bags.

faq.question: Can I rent a seven seater self drive car in Kanyakumari?
faq.answer: Yes — the Rumion or the Innova, whichever is free on your dates. Both are delivered to Kanyakumari: to the railway station, to a hotel near the beach, or wherever you are staying. The Rumion is the petrol one and costs less over a day inside the district; the Innova is the one for luggage and long days.

models.name: Toyota Innova
models.luggage: Large — suitcases for a full group, with all three rows in use
models.title: Toyota Innova Self Drive & Tour Rental, Nagercoil
models.description: Rent a Toyota Innova in Nagercoil and Kanyakumari district — 7 seats, diesel, for weddings, airport runs and multi-day tours. Rates agreed before you leave.
models.intro: The Innova is the long-distance vehicle. It is what gets booked for a wedding party, for a Thiruvananthapuram airport run at four in the morning, and for the multi-day tours where seven people and their luggage have to travel together and arrive unbothered. A self drive Innova in Nagercoil is what goes out for the long days, and it arrives with the KM limit written down before it leaves.
models.suits: Wedding parties, airport transfers, multi-day tours, and any group of six or seven with real luggage.
models.drive: It is the most settled vehicle we keep on a highway — heavy, quiet at speed and comfortable over long distances in a way the hatchbacks are not. The diesel pulls from low revs, which suits a loaded vehicle on the climbs inland. In town it is the biggest thing we hand over, so allow for the length when parking, and think ahead on the narrow temple streets.
good: The best long-distance comfort in the fleet, loaded or empty
A third row adults can sit in for hours
Boot space for a full group's luggage
models.watch: It is long, and the streets around the older temples were not built for it. For town errands and tight parking a hatchback is the easier choice; take the Innova for the distance, not for the market run.

faq.question: Can I rent an Innova with a driver?
faq.answer: Yes. Self drive and with a driver are both possible — for airport runs at odd hours and for multi-day tours most people take a driver. Tell us which you want when you enquire and the rate is quoted accordingly.

faq.question: Is the Innova used for weddings?
faq.answer: It is the usual choice for the family vehicles alongside a decorated car for the couple. Muhurtham dates go months ahead, so book early — see our wedding cars page for how that works.

faq.question: Is it worth it for a trip inside the district?
faq.answer: Only if you need the seats or the luggage space. For four people staying inside Kanyakumari district a hatchback costs less to rent and less to fuel. The Innova earns its rate on distance, on load, and on comfort over a long day.

faq.question: Can I take a self drive Innova to Thiruvananthapuram airport?
faq.answer: Yes, and it is one of the commonest reasons it goes out — seven people and their luggage, at four in the morning, in one vehicle. Tell us when you book if you are crossing into Kerala, so the paperwork we hand over is right before you set off rather than after.
